# Run origins and typing lines into agent terminals

## What to build

The plumbing of KAN-92's supervisor in graph-manager (`apps/graph-manager`), spec `docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md` ("Run origins and the supervisor (KAN-92)"). graph-manager must remember **which agent terminal started each run** (its *origin*), and must be able to **type one line into an agent terminal once it is quiet**. A later slice adds the watcher that turns run status changes into lines; this slice adds everything it needs, fully tested on its own:

1. **`RunOrigins`** (new `src/server/run-origins.ts`): an in-memory map `(wsId, runId) → terminalId` on `AppContext` as `ctx.runOrigins`.
2. **`TerminalManager.typeWhenIdle(id, line): boolean`** (`src/server/terminals.ts`): queues a line per terminal; types queued lines one at a time once the terminal has had no output for `WORKING_MS` (3 s): writes the line (control characters stripped), then `"\r"` 100 ms later. Drops the line instead of typing when the terminal has no `agent` or its foreground process is the shell it was spawned with (the user quit the agent: the shell would execute the text). Killing or removing the terminal drops its queue. Returns `false` when the terminal is unknown or isn't an agent terminal, else `true`.
3. **Recording origins** at every place an agent can start a run:
   - the `graph-execution` **shim** (`src/server/shim.ts`, engine mode): picks the run id itself (`gm-<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<4 hex>`), passes it to the engine as `GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID`, and tells the server with `POST /api/internal/run-origins { terminalId, cwd, runId }` before spawning the engine (best effort). With `--resume --run <id>` it registers `<id>` (and sets no env).
   - new internal route **`POST /api/internal/run-origins`** (`src/server/routes/internal.ts`).
   - **sandbox runs**: the shim adds `terminalId: env.GM_TERMINAL_ID` to the `POST /api/internal/sandbox-runs` body; the route records the origin of the new or resumed run.
   - **`POST /api/runs/:ws`** (`src/server/routes/runs.ts`): optional `originTerminalId` in the body, recorded after the run starts when that terminal exists.

A run started from the UI without an agent request has no origin. Origins are not persisted (terminals don't survive a restart either).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md` — Decisions rows 1–5 (typing, dropping, in-memory origins, who records origins, the shim picks the run id) and the bullets `terminals.ts` / `Origins` under "Run origins and the supervisor (KAN-92)".
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` (whole file, 394 lines): `Term` (lines 67–88: `agent`, `lastOutputAt`, `burstAt`, `exitCode`, `proc`, `argv`), `WORKING_MS` (line 91), `TerminalManagerOptions` (lines 49–59), `create` (185–210), `spawn` (212–228, sets `GM_TERMINAL_ID`), `wire` (231–259: `onData` updates `lastOutputAt`), `restart` (266–279), `kill` (333–341), `remove` (344–351), `disposeAll` (353–355), `info()` (369–385) and `processOf()` (387–394: `path.basename(proc.process)`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts` (lines 51–79) — an agent terminal is spawned as the plain shell (`argv = [shell]`) with `agent: adapter.id` and `input: commandLine(launch.argv) + "\r"` typed at spawn; so "foreground process is the shell it was spawned with" means `processOf(term.proc).process === path.basename(term.argv[0])`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.test.ts` (lines 1–35 setup helpers, 233–265 agent terminal and foreground process tests) — the test style to extend.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/shim.ts` (whole file, 110 lines) and `shim.test.ts` (whole file, 75 lines). The shim is **dependency-free on purpose: only `node:` imports** (it runs from `dist/server` alone). Do not import from `./routes/*`, `graph-execution/api`, `zod` or `execa` there.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.ts` (whole file, 160 lines): `body` / `toolCallBody` schemas (lines 16–17), `SUBCOMMANDS` (line 20), `scanArgs` (34–55), `denied` (67–73), `workspaceOf` (76–82), `POST /api/internal/tools/:name` (92–112, shows `ctx.terminals.get(terminalId)` → 400 `unknown terminal <id>`), `POST /api/internal/sandbox-runs` (114–159: resume branch lines 127–131 returns `res.runId`; new run lines 146–152).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.test.ts` (lines 1–76 setup with fake Docker and `buildApp(config, { …, internalToken: TOKEN })`; 108–122 "starts a new run in a sandbox"; 161–181 shim over loopback).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal-tools.test.ts` (lines 33–46) — how a test creates a terminal: log in, then `POST /api/terminals { workspaceId: "github~octo~hello" }` with the cookie.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (lines 17–24 `startBody`, 29–36 `newRunId`, 86–157 `POST /api/runs/:ws`: sandbox branch returns at line 126 with `runId`; non-sandbox returns at line 156 with `id`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts` (lines 1–66) — POST /api/runs with `sandbox: true` against fake Docker; the place to test `originTerminalId` without a built engine.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 38–69 `AppContext` / `BuildAppOptions`, line 101 `ctx`) and `src/server/test-helpers.ts` (lines 37–61 `appWithLogin`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/startup.ts` (lines 58–79) — the engine honours `GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID` (must match `/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$/`) for a new run.

## Patterns to follow

**RunOrigins** (new file `src/server/run-origins.ts`, exact API — later slices call it):
```ts
/** Which terminal started each run (docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md). In memory: terminals don't survive a restart either. */
export class RunOrigins {
  private readonly map = new Map<string, { wsId: string; runId: string; terminalId: string }>();
  private static key(wsId: string, runId: string): string { return `${wsId}/${runId}`; }
  set(wsId: string, runId: string, terminalId: string): void { this.map.set(RunOrigins.key(wsId, runId), { wsId, runId, terminalId }); }
  get(wsId: string, runId: string): string | undefined { return this.map.get(RunOrigins.key(wsId, runId))?.terminalId; }
  delete(wsId: string, runId: string): void { this.map.delete(RunOrigins.key(wsId, runId)); }
  entries(): { wsId: string; runId: string; terminalId: string }[] { return [...this.map.values()].map((e) => ({ ...e })); }
}
```
`set` on an existing run replaces its terminal (`resume_run` makes the caller the new origin).

**AppContext wiring** (`app.ts`): add `/** Which agent terminal started each run (docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md). */ runOrigins: RunOrigins;` to `AppContext`, `runOrigins?: RunOrigins` to `BuildAppOptions` ("a given instance (tests)"), and `runOrigins: opts.runOrigins ?? new RunOrigins()` in the `ctx` literal at line 101. Then in `test-helpers.ts` let `appWithLogin(overrides: Partial<Config> = {}, appOpts: Pick<BuildAppOptions, "runOrigins" | "tools"> = {})` pass `...appOpts` into `buildApp` (existing callers keep working).

**Control-character stripping** — ESLint's `no-control-regex` (from `js.configs.recommended`) rejects `/[\x00-\x1f]/`; strip with char codes:
```ts
/** `line` without C0/C1 control characters and DEL: typed into a PTY, they would act as keys (Enter, Ctrl+C, escapes). */
export function printable(line: string): string {
  let out = "";
  for (const ch of line) {
    const c = ch.codePointAt(0)!;
    if (c >= 0x20 && c !== 0x7f && !(c >= 0x80 && c <= 0x9f)) out += ch;
  }
  return out;
}
```

**Foreground check** (reuse `processOf`, lines 387–394):
```ts
const fg = processOf(term.proc).process;
const shellInFront = fg !== undefined && fg === path.basename(term.argv[0]);
```

**Internal route pattern** (mirror `POST /api/internal/tools/:name`, lines 92–100):
```ts
const no = denied(req, ctx);
if (no) return reply.code(no.code).send({ error: no.error });
```

**Run id in the shim** — same format as `newRunId` in `routes/runs.ts` lines 29–36, re-implemented locally with `node:crypto`'s `randomBytes` (the shim may not import `routes/runs.ts`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/run-origins.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `RunOrigins` exactly as above.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/run-origins.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: set/get/delete/entries; `set` twice for the same run replaces the terminal and keeps one entry; runs of two workspaces with the same run id stay separate; `entries()` returns copies (mutating one does not change the map).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/run-origins.test.ts`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` and `apps/graph-manager/src/server/test-helpers.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the wiring above. Additive edits only (other parallel tasks also add fields and route lines in `app.ts`).
- **IMPORTS**: `import { RunOrigins } from "./run-origins.js";` in `app.ts`; `import { buildApp, type BuildAppOptions } from "./app.js";` in `test-helpers.ts`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `TerminalManagerOptions`: `typeIdleMs?: number` ("quiet time before `typeWhenIdle` types; default WORKING_MS (tests shorten it)") and `typeEnterDelayMs?: number` (default 100).
  - `Term`: `queue: string[]`, `typer?: NodeJS.Timeout`, `typedAt?: number` (ms of the last `"\r"`). Initialise `queue: []` in `create`.
  - `export function printable(line)` (above).
  - `typeWhenIdle(id: string, line: string): boolean` with a JSDoc: unknown id or no `agent` → `false`; else push `printable(line)` and call `this.pump(term)`; return `true`.
  - `private pump(term: Term): void`:
    1. return when `term.typer` is set (a timer is pending), the queue is empty, or `this.terms.get(term.id) !== term` (removed).
    2. `quietSince = Math.max(term.lastOutputAt?.getTime() ?? 0, term.typedAt ?? 0)`; `wait = idleMs - (Date.now() - quietSince)`. If `wait > 0`: `term.typer = setTimeout(() => { term.typer = undefined; this.pump(term); }, wait)` (call `.unref()` on it) and return. Output during the wait moves `lastOutputAt`; pump re-checks when the timer fires, so a busy agent keeps postponing.
    3. If `term.exitCode !== undefined`, or `!term.agent`, or the foreground check says the shell is in front: `term.queue.length = 0` and return (dropped, never typed).
    4. `term.proc.write(term.queue.shift()!)`, then `term.typer = setTimeout(() => { term.typer = undefined; if (term.exitCode === undefined && this.terms.get(term.id) === term) { term.proc.write("\r"); term.typedAt = Date.now(); } this.pump(term); }, enterDelayMs)` (unref).
  - `kill(id)`: clear the queue and `clearTimeout(term.typer)`; `term.typer = undefined` (do this before the early return for an exited terminal too). `remove(id)` calls `kill`, so it drops it as well; `disposeAll` therefore clears every timer.
- **PATTERN**: the existing `wire()` (lines 231–259) is where `lastOutputAt` moves; do not change it.
- **GOTCHA**: `WORKING_MS` stays the public "working" threshold; only the new option defaults to it. Don't change `info()` / `TerminalInfo`. A pending typer must never keep the test process alive (`unref`). Never write into an exited `proc`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** (inside `describe.skipIf(skip)("TerminalManager", …)`; build the manager with `new TerminalManager({ workspacesDir: dir, typeIdleMs: 400, typeEnterDelayMs: 50 })` instead of `setup()`'s default, remember to assign the module-level `mgr`/`cleanup` so `afterEach` disposes it):
  - A **fake agent** script written to the temp dir, e.g. `agent.cjs`:
    ```js
    process.stdin.setRawMode?.(true);
    process.stdout.write("ready\n");
    process.stdin.on("data", (d) => process.stdout.write("got:" + JSON.stringify(String(d)) + "\n"));
    ```
    started as `mgr.create({ cwd: dir, agent: "claude", command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", \`exec "${process.execPath}" "${script}"\`] })`. With `exec`, the PTY's foreground process becomes `node` while `argv[0]` is `/bin/sh`, so the foreground check passes. (Spawning `[process.execPath, script]` directly would make the foreground name equal `basename(argv[0])` = `node` and the line would be dropped.)
  - "types a queued line once the agent terminal is quiet, then Enter": wait for `ready`, call `typeWhenIdle(id, "[graph-manager] Run r1 started (tasks).")` → `true`; after ~100 ms the output has no `got:`; within ~2 s it contains `got:"[graph-manager] Run r1 started (tasks)."` followed by a separate `got:"\r"`.
  - "types queued lines one at a time, in order": two lines queued back to back arrive in order, each followed by `"\r"`.
  - "strips control characters": `typeWhenIdle(id, "a\u001b[31mb\nc\u0003")` → the agent receives `"a[31mbc"`.
  - "drops the line for a plain terminal and an unknown id": `mgr.create({ cwd: dir, command: ["/bin/sh"] })` (no `agent`) → `typeWhenIdle` returns `false`; `typeWhenIdle("t999", "x")` → `false`.
  - "drops the line when the agent terminal's shell is in front": `mgr.create({ cwd: dir, agent: "claude", command: ["/bin/sh"] })` (interactive sh, nothing started) → `typeWhenIdle(id, "echo TYPED_$((40+2))")` returns `true`, but after 1.5 s the output does not contain `TYPED_42` (and does not contain `echo TYPED_`).
  - "drops the queue on kill": queue a line, `mgr.kill(id)` before the quiet time passes, wait 1 s: nothing typed (the agent output has no `got:`).
- **PATTERN**: `terminals.test.ts:233-252` (polling `waitFor` helper on the collected output).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/terminals.test.ts`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/shim.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `ShimIo.spawnEngine: (args: string[], env?: Record<string, string>) => Promise<number>` — `env` is added to the engine child's environment. In `main()` / the local `spawnEngine(bin, args, env?)`, spawn with `{ stdio: "inherit", env: { ...process.env, ...env } }`.
  - `export function shimRunId(now = new Date()): string` — `gm-<yyyymmdd>-<hhmmss>-<4 hex>` in local time (copy of `newRunId`, using `randomBytes(2).toString("hex")` from `node:crypto`).
  - `export function originOf(args: string[], env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): { runId: string; setEnv: boolean } | undefined` — the run this command starts or resumes:
    - `undefined` when any arg is `--help`, `-h`, `--version`, `-V` or `--web-serve`, or when the first arg that doesn't start with `-` is one of `suite clean list open install readme skills` (same set as `SUBCOMMANDS` in `routes/internal.ts` line 20; copy it, don't import).
    - With `--resume`: the value of `--run <id>` or `--run=<id>` → `{ runId: id, setEnv: false }`; no `--run` → `undefined`.
    - Else, when `env.GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID` is already set → `{ runId: thatValue, setEnv: false }`; otherwise `{ runId: shimRunId(), setEnv: true }`.
    - Any runId not matching `/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$/` → `undefined`.
  - In `runShim`, engine mode: when `env.GM_INTERNAL_URL`, `env.GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN` and `env.GM_TERMINAL_ID` are all set and `originOf(plan.args, env)` gives an origin: `await` a `POST ${base}/api/internal/run-origins` with `authorization: Bearer <token>`, `content-type: application/json`, body `{ terminalId: env.GM_TERMINAL_ID, cwd: io.cwd, runId }` and `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2000)`, inside `try { … } catch { /* best effort */ }` — print nothing on any failure or non-2xx answer. Then `io.spawnEngine(plan.args, { GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID: runId })` when `setEnv`, else `io.spawnEngine(plan.args)` (call with **one** argument when there is no env: the existing test asserts `toHaveBeenCalledWith(["x", "--web"])`). Without the three variables: exactly today's behaviour, no fetch.
  - Sandbox mode: add `terminalId: env.GM_TERMINAL_ID` to the JSON body only when it is set (`...(env.GM_TERMINAL_ID ? { terminalId: env.GM_TERMINAL_ID } : {})`), so the existing body assertion (`{ cwd, args }` with an env lacking it) still holds.
  - Update the file's header comment (lines 1–3) to mention the origin.
- **IMPORTS**: `import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";` — nothing outside `node:`.
- **GOTCHA**: terminals strip an inherited `GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID` (`STRIPPED_ENV` in `terminals.ts` line 97), so normally the shim generates one. Never set `GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID` for `--resume`. The engine still runs when the POST fails or hangs (the 2 s timeout).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `ctx.runOrigins` is a `RunOrigins` with `set(wsId, runId, terminalId)`, `get(wsId, runId)`, `delete(wsId, runId)`, `entries()`; `BuildAppOptions.runOrigins` injects one; `appWithLogin(overrides, { runOrigins })` passes it through.
- [ ] `TerminalManager.typeWhenIdle(id, line)` returns `false` for an unknown or non-agent terminal; for an agent terminal it types the line only after `typeIdleMs` (default `WORKING_MS` = 3000) without output, control characters stripped, then `"\r"` `typeEnterDelayMs` (default 100) later; lines one at a time in order; nothing is typed when the shell is the foreground process or the terminal exited; `kill`/`remove` drop the queue.
- [ ] The shim, in a graph-manager terminal (`GM_INTERNAL_URL`, `GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN`, `GM_TERMINAL_ID`), POSTs `/api/internal/run-origins { terminalId, cwd, runId }` before spawning a run and sets `GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID=<runId>` (format `gm-<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<4 hex>`) for the engine; `--resume --run <id>` registers `<id>` without the env; subcommands, `--help`, `--version` and `--resume` without `--run` register nothing; a failed POST prints nothing and the engine still runs.
